_readme: Which tests check which acceptance criteria. Stories and their criteria come from Linear; this file only links them to tests.
Keys are Linear issue ids, then the criterion's number as the dashboard shows it (AC1 is "1").
"match" is a few words from the criterion. If someone edits the story in Linear so the words no longer appear, the link is shown as out of date instead of silently pointing at the wrong criterion.
"tests" are "<file> > <test name>", exactly as node --test names them (suite names joined with " > ").
"manual" marks a criterion that is checked by hand, with where the evidence is. "note" is shown under the criterion.
A test can also link itself by putting the id and criterion in its name, for example test("SI-70 AC4: the next activity is shown after one passes", ...).
